repository_purpose: Experimental parallel-generation system that can run finite batches or unbounded waves through a Claude slash command.
findings: The project is valuable as a batch-coordination reference, but its infinite mode conflicts directly with the parent wrapper stop doctrine.
The only reusable parent idea is bounded wave management for finite iteration counts.
Keeping it as a reference packet is better than deleting it because the conflict is exact and source-backed.

capability_rows.validation_method: Validate that any future reuse remains finite, explicitly bounded, and stop-reason-aware; reject infinite mode for the parent wrapper.
capability_rows.blocker_or_dependency: Reference only because the upstream infinite mode conflicts with bounded stop, plateau, and exact-blocker doctrine.

trigger_logic: Only finite batch orchestration ideas are eligible for later reuse.
actor_logic: A dev driver or experiment owner would own any bounded-wave adaptation.
validation_summary: Reject any implementation that silently restores infinite mode.

overlaps: Overlaps with the parent program only as a cautionary foil for stop conditions and bounded budgets.
